entry.author: Selwyn District Council
entry.summary:
The Central Government is considering changes to how local and regional government is organised through its Head Start reforms. These changes could affect how local decisions are made and how services are delivered in Selwyn. Council wants to understand what matters most to our community to help inform future discussions. If you need more information, you can visit our dedicated Head Start webpage at https://www.selwyn.govt.nz/your-council/local-government-reforms?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=headstart_june_26

You can complete the survey by going to https://www.selwyn.govt.nz/headstart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=headstart_june_26
